content_data.project_description: A comprehensive digital engagement strategy to deepen fan connections across North American markets through personalized content, gamification, and real-time interactive experiences during live sporting events.
content_data.timeline: 12 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4) focusing on platform development, Phase 2 (months 5-8) on content creation and testing, and Phase 3 (months 9-12) on full market rollout
content_data.project_lead: Priya Nakamura, Senior Marketing Manager - Digital Engagement
objectives: Create new revenue streams through premium digital content offerings
deliverables: Interactive social media campaign framework for 50+ game days
Comprehensive analytics dashboard for engagement tracking
success_metrics: Social media engagement rate improvement of 40%
Mobile app downloads exceeding 250,000 within first 6 months
